CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red locations), an explicit organizational description (axis orientation), and an explicit origin/status entry co-occur for the same current referent.

A.rationale: No text links an attention/allocation or processing condition to the same content's presentation or access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified content (red) and its coordinate set for a current referent.

D.rationale: The report separates content (coordinate listings) from an explicit origin/status field for the same current item.

O.rationale: An explicit statement describes how grid content is organized/presented (axis orientation) for current items.
